title: Incremental Validation Engine
objective: Classify diffs and select the minimum safe validation depth so routine development stays fast while sensitive changes receive stronger assurance.
forbidden_scope: ENG-04 security-toolchain implementation beyond interfaces needed by ENG-03

tasks.description: Implement a deterministic multi-label Git diff classifier.
Implement impact and test-dependency mapping from diff classes.
Define and enforce T0 instant validation checks.
Define and enforce T1 targeted validation checks.
Define and enforce T2 domain validation checks.
Select T3 assurance and T4 certification only when risk requires them.
Implement safe exact-input proof reuse and cache semantics.
Measure validation overhead and prove incremental checks avoid unnecessary work.

done_when: every changed path receives deterministic conservative diff labels
impact mapping selects only relevant tests/check families without weakening risk floors
T0 T1 and T2 are explicit and machine-selected
T3/T4 cannot be bypassed for sensitive changes
safe proof reuse is bound to exact relevant inputs
documentation-only work does not trigger execution-domain certification
measured routine validation overhead stays materially below blanket full-suite execution
